savings.reason: Reading record scale/readings/LSP-EO_13990.json (EO 13990, 86 FR 7037-7043, read once in full): sec. 7(a) revokes EO 13795 with no savings clause; sec. 8(a) saves only statutory agency authority; sec. 7(f) tells the OMB Director and agency heads to rescind issuances implementing or enforcing the revoked orders; sec. 4(b) reinstates EO 13754 and the December 20, 2016 memorandum 'in their original form' and names no other memorandum. Own-residual check, reading EO 13795 in full: sec. 5 is self-executing. It modifies 'to read, in its entirety' the body text of three OCS withdrawal memoranda (December 20, 2016; January 27, 2015; July 14, 2008), withdrawing the sanctuary areas 'for a time period without specific expiration', and adds that 'nothing in the withdrawal under this section affects any rights under existing leases'. A modification already made to other Presidential instruments, and a lease-rights proviso, do not lapse when the modifying order is revoked. EO 13990 sec. 4(b) undoes the change only for the December 20, 2016 memorandum (and EO 13754, revoked by sec. 4(c)); it does not mention the January 27, 2015 or July 14, 2008 memoranda, so by its terms their text as modified stays. The status of the 2015 and 2008 memoranda today is not searched here.

research_rationale: EO 13795 (signed 2017-04-28, 82 FR 20815-20818), read in full from the held FR text, sets an offshore energy strategy: lease-sale scheduling and seismic permitting (sec. 3), a sanctuary and marine-monument designation review with a 180-day report (sec. 4(a)-(b)), the revocation of EO 13754 (sec. 4(c)), a modification of three OCS withdrawal memoranda (sec. 5), several rule and guidance reviews (secs. 6-11) and general provisions. The only own-term hits are the implementation condition (sec. 13(b)) and the 60- and 180-day periods, which are deadlines, not ends. EO 13990 (86 FR 7037-7043, read in full; reading record scale/readings/LSP-EO_13990.json) sec. 7(a) revokes it, effective on signing, 2021-01-20. EO 13990 sec. 4(b), the same day, reinstates EO 13754 and the December 20, 2016 memorandum 'in their original form' (86 FR 7039; the U.S. Code notes to 15 U.S.C. 4101 and 43 U.S.C. 1331 record the reinstatement and the revocation). No later amendment of EO 13795 before the revocation appears in the held FR texts (by-number scan of all 6,652 held FR-original texts: only EO 13990 names it), the OFR catalog edges or the U.S. Code notes. EO 14148 and EO 14154 (2025) revoke EO 13990 but name none of the six orders and reinstate nothing. Inventory: the dossier's 24 clauses cover the operative text from sec. 1 through sec. 13(c). Savings: the S0 prefill is overruled, see savings_residuals.
